name: contact-link-identity
description: Add a channel identity (email, phone, Signal, Telegram, Slack) to an existing contact. If the result says the address may already belong to someone else, use that contact id, or pass confirm_new true only when this is a different person. An address already on file is refused even with confirm_new. The identity is source agent_created: an agent supplied it, which is not the same as the principal confirming it. To update profile attributes (title, organization, timezone, etc.), use contact-update instead.

inputs.label: string?
inputs.confirm_new: boolean? (true only after a refusal said this is a different person. Does not override an address that is already on file.)
